items.Sentence: The treatment system consists of screening, grit removal, two oxidation ditches, three secondary clarifiers, a concrete lined equalization basin, a 6-acre, clay-lined flow equalization basin used for temporarily holding secondary undisinfected wastewater when influent flows exceed the tertiary filtration design capacity during long-term storm events, tertiary filtration and ultraviolet disinfection to treat a design daily average flow of 3.0 mgd and design daily peak flow of 6.8 mgd.
